concept.title: ReadMe (readme.com)
concept.shortdesc: ReadMe is a hosted documentation platform with a docs-as-code approach. It lets you write content

conbody.p: ReadMe is a hosted documentation platform with a docs-as-code approach. It lets you write content in Markdown (with YAML front matter) in a Git repository and then sync it to the ReadMe site via their CLI/GitHub Action. Under the hood, ReadMe uses React for its web UI, and files are created in Markdown and configured with front matter. The front matter is YAML (inside +++ or --- blocks) with fields like title, excerpt, category, metadata, link, api, etc. These fields control how pages appear in the ReadMe interface.
